com.jasonwjones.common - package com.jasonwjones.common
Small, generic helpers shared across this library's REST clients.
com.jasonwjones.di - package com.jasonwjones.di
Public client API for the unofficial Data Management (DM/AIF) REST service, a separate service from the main PBCS/Planning REST API used for jobs and application/dimension metadata that the Planning API doesn't expose.
com.jasonwjones.di.api.v1 - package com.jasonwjones.di.api.v1
Maps the request/response payloads for the Data Management (DM/AIF) REST API.
com.jasonwjones.di.impl - package com.jasonwjones.di.impl
Default implementation of the Data Management (DM/AIF) client API.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs
Root package for the PBJ client library.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.aif - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.aif
Maps the request/response payloads for the unofficial, admin-gated AIF REST endpoint historically used to discover application and dimension metadata before PBCS/EPM Cloud exposed an official API for it (see PlanTypeDimension for the modern replacement).
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3 - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3
Maps the request/response payloads for the PBCS/EPM Cloud Planning REST API (v3), including hypermedia plumbing shared across many endpoints such as HypermediaLink and AbstractHypermediaResponse.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.dataslices - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.dataslices
Maps the request/response payloads used to export and import data slices (grids of cell data), plus a GridDefinitionBuilder for constructing requests.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client
The main public API for the PBCS/EPM Cloud Planning REST API: PbcsPlanningClient for the connection, PbcsApplication for an application, PbcsPlanType for a cube, and PbcsMember for outline members.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.exceptions - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.exceptions
Exceptions thrown by this library's Planning REST API client, rooted at PbcsClientException.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl
Default implementation of the com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client API.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.export - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.export
Callback implementations and options for printing an export in various text formats (fixed-width, Markdown), for use with PbcsPlanType.ExportCallback.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.grid - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.grid
A PovGrid view over a data slice response, plus a plain-text printer for it.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.interceptors - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.interceptors
RestTemplate request interceptors used internally to attach credentials/tokens and log requests and responses.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.membervisitors - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.impl.membervisitors
PlanTypeWalker.Visitor implementations that collect members matching a MemberSearchQuery while walking a plan type's dimension hierarchy, in support of PbcsPlanType.searchMembers(com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.MemberSearchQuery).
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.memberdimensioncache - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.memberdimensioncache
Pluggable caching strategies for member/dimension lookups and aliases, implementing PbcsPlanType.MemberDimensionCache and PbcsPlanType.MemberResolver.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso
OAuth/IDCS authentication flows (authorization code, device code, JWT assertion) for connecting to EPM Cloud environments that require single sign-on rather than native username/password credentials.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso.entity - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso.entity
Maps the request/response payloads used by the OAuth/IDCS authentication flows in com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.interop - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.interop
Public client API for PBCS/EPM Cloud's Lifecycle Management (LCM) functionality - application snapshots, backup/restore, and file upload/download - centered on InteropClient.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.interop.impl - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.interop.impl
Default implementation of InteropClient, plus the application snapshot models (ApplicationSnapshot, ApplicationSnapshotInfo) it returns.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.interop.model - package com.jasonwjones.pbcs.interop.model
